name: Moriki Shuzo
about: Moriki Shuzo is a sake brewery in Iga, Mie. Its founder had a well dug by a priest and opened the brewery there, and named the first brand Tae no Hana after the Lotus Sutra. In 1992 the creator of the manga Natsuko no Sake named a new sake Rumiko no Sake, after Rumiko Moriki of the brewery.

Since 1998 every sake has been junmai, made from rice, koji and water only, at about 300 koku a year. All koji is made in wooden trays, and since 2016 the kimoto and yamahai starters use no added yeast. The brewery also grows its own organic Yamadanishiki, and Rie Toyomoto is its toji.
